[USER] User is looking for new healthy snack ideas that are easy to grab and go.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Healthy snacking is a great habit to cultivate!  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested easy, grab-and-go snack ideas include:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] **Fresh Fruits:** Apples, bananas, oranges, grapes, cut up fresh fruit like watermelon, pineapple, or berries.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] **Nuts and Seeds:** Almonds, walnuts, cashews, pistachios, trail mix with nuts, seeds, and dried fruits, sunflower seeds, or pumpkin seeds.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] **Veggie Delights:** Carrot sticks with hummus, cherry tomatoes with balsamic vinegar, cucumber slices or baby bell peppers with guacamole.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] **Protein-rich Snacks:** Hard-boiled eggs, Greek yogurt or cottage cheese, beef or turkey jerky (look for low-sodium options).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] **Whole Grain Goodness:** Whole grain crackers with peanut butter or almond butter, oat energy balls made with rolled oats, nuts, and dried fruits, whole grain granola bars (look for low-sugar options).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] **Other Healthy Options:** Edamame or roasted chickpeas seasoned with herbs and spices, cut up veggies with ranch or tzatziki sauce, smoothie packs (frozen fruit, spinach, and almond milk), dark chocolate squares (at least 70% cocoa), energy balls made with dates, nuts, and coconut flakes.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] **Homemade Snack Ideas:** Roasted sweet potato slices seasoned with cinnamon and nutmeg, homemade granola made with rolled oats, nuts, and seeds, energy bars made with rolled oats, nuts, and dried fruits, cut up veggie sticks with homemade guacamole or hummus.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Remember, portion control is key when it comes to snacking. Aim for 100-200 calorie snacks to keep you satisfied between meals. Enjoy!
